verdict.rationale: Perplexity's Search API docs explicitly list "domain filtering" as a feature, alongside "advanced filtering" of ranked web results, which directly addresses restricting results by domain. The evidence is only a brief feature-list mention, though, with no parameter details or examples. Missing for 10: documented parameter names and syntax, explicit confirmation of both allowlist (restrict) and denylist (exclude) modes, whether filtering also applies to Sonar/Agent answers, limits on the number of domains, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
